expected_effect: Lower val_bpb at matched step count: predicted -0.002 (range -0.005 to +0.003), with step count within 2% of the 2071-step control because operator count and parameter count are unchanged (only dependency order moves).
hypothesis: At 9a4caa7b the trained depthwise local convolution in each Block is added to the residual AFTER the q_in/k_in/v_in snapshots (and the Q/K shift) are taken, a leftover of commit 7518d91e's rejected MUDD experiment, so same-block attention never sees the conv output and the conv only reaches the MLP and later blocks. Re-ordering the existing conv residual update ahead of the snapshots on the default serial path (parallel_block off, mlp_sandwich off) hands attention a locally-mixed Q/K/V input (the Canon-A placement of arXiv:2512.17351 and this file's own earlier pre-attention wiring) with zero new parameters or ops, improving loss per step at unchanged step count.
implementation_plan: All edits confined to train.py on branch autoloop/20260923-local-conv-pre-attn-serial-only-r3 from 9a4caa7b. STEP 1 (static inspection only; record findings as notes in the implementation summary; no execution, no artifacts): (a) in Block.forward locate, for the default serial path, (i) the first statement that reads x to build the q_in/k_in/v_in residual snapshots (and the Q/K shift that follows), and (ii) the existing conv residual update `x = x + self.local_conv(norm(x))` together with its existing guard (copy the exact expression as written, including any --nki-local-conv dispatch); confirm that (ii) currently executes after (i). Record the exact attribute used to detect the parallel path (expected: self.par_lambda_a is None means serial) and the global used for the sandwich path (expected: USE_MLP_SANDWICH_NORM). (b) locate the --cautious-wd boolean-toggle pattern: module constant USE_CAUTIOUS_WD, its NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_* env override, the argparse --cautious-wd/--no-cautious-wd pair, and the main() assignment into the global. (c) locate ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES, current_toggles(), the `_EVAL_TOGGLE_DEFAULTS = current_toggles()` line, and restore_eval_toggles' `saved.get(name, _EVAL_TOGGLE_DEFAULTS[name])` loop; confirm whether restore_eval_toggles is ever called with a dict that could lack keys (legacy checkpoints) versus the in-process current_toggles() dict. STEP 2 (toggle): immediately after the USE_LOCAL_CONV / TRAIN_LOCAL_CONV constants add `USE_LOCAL_CONV_PRE_ATTN = os.environ.get("NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_LOCAL_CONV_PRE_ATTN", "1") != "0"` with a 3-6 line comment stating: the 7518d91e snapshot ordering left same-block attention reading pre-conv residuals; True moves the existing conv update ahead of the snapshots on the default serial path only; False is bit-identical to 9a4caa7b. Confirm by reading that with USE_LOCAL_CONV_PRE_ATTN=False every executed statement and its order equals 9a4caa7b. Report the STEP 1 notes and the diff in the implementation summary; runtime behaviour (causality 0.0, step rate, bpb) is checked by the smoke abort conditions, not before the implementation gate.
selection_rationale: The local-conv wiring repair is the only candidate that combines (a) a confirmed source-level defect (verified twice against authoritative Block.forward), (b) explicit endorsement as the strongest next lead in CURRENT_STATE, (c) primary-source architectural support, and (d) zero added operators/parameters so the expected throughput term is near zero. Its two prior attempts failed only on implementation-boundary details (sandwich-path leakage, legacy-checkpoint default), each now closed with an explicit spec, so the evidence-adjusted probability of reaching a clean full run is highest. The Muon and FP8 lanes have larger theoretical upside but need multi-cycle groundwork; the ngram-layers and schedule flags carry unknown-duplicate risk and small bounded upside. Cost is one smoke plus one full run (~0.6 host-hours).
single_causal_change: One wiring change confined to train.py: new module-level boolean USE_LOCAL_CONV_PRE_ATTN (default True on the candidate branch; env NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_LOCAL_CONV_PRE_ATTN='0' disables; CLI --local-conv-pre-attn/--no-local-conv-pre-attn following the --cautious-wd boolean-pair pattern; appended to ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES so the checkpoint persists it, with an explicit name-specific missing-key fallback of False in restore_eval_toggles so legacy checkpoints rebuild the historical ordering). When True, ONLY in the default serial Block.forward path (self.par_lambda_a is None and not USE_MLP_SANDWICH_NORM) of blocks whose local_conv is not None, the EXISTING conv residual update statement (copied verbatim, including any --nki-local-conv dispatch) executes immediately BEFORE the q_in/k_in/v_in snapshots and Q/K shift instead of after them; the historical conv site is guarded with the complementary condition so each active conv runs exactly once. Parallel-block and mlp-sandwich paths keep their exact 9a4caa7b statements and order. No kernel, parameter, optimizer, precision, schedule, data, or evaluator change; with the toggle off the file is bit-identical in behaviour to 9a4caa7b.
